description: This file defines an authentication context for a React.js single-page application, managing user login, registration, and logout states, and handling JWT token storage and decoding.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React context provider component that manages authentication state and provides login, register, and logout functions.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, retrieves a JWT token, and updates context state.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with name, email, and password, prompting login upon success.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user by clearing authentication state and local storage.
